name: Escape Green
notes: Escape Green 0.2.0-r4. The first-person held item now matches the selected hotbar slot (sword, pickaxe, axe, a small textured cube for blocks, torch, bread for food, empty hand otherwise) and the pickaxe plays a dig swing on left-click. The sword sits bottom-right like the HUD mock and is capped at about 15% of the screen width. Bunnies use a light cream/white coat with pink inner ears and a soft underside shadow instead of a heavy dark outline. F6 meadow lands about 6–10 m from 2–3 slightly larger chickens. Meadow on F6, unified block mining, calm readout/toast, F7, 40–500 ms double-tap, phone 390 px I/B, egSchema v1→v2, escape-green IDB/cacheId, and the SW denylist are unchanged from r3. PROXY High <=150, Low <=62. Do not mutate after SHA256SUMS.
